scope: Dense wire and current-flow rendering before OPT-008

observations.schematicWireMounts: CircuitCanvas mounts one WireShape, including outline and interactive line nodes, for every wire regardless of viewport intersection
observations.pcbWireMounts: PCB trace mode builds a Konva line for every wire regardless of viewport intersection
observations.flowPathCompilation: CurrentFlowLayer computes routed polyline segments for every canvas wire whenever wire or node topology changes
observations.flowFrameScope: Every Konva animation frame scans every compiled path and draws every eligible particle
observations.particleBudget: Particle count grows with every active wire length and has no global or per-wire cap
observations.overviewCadence: Current-flow animation requests a layer redraw at display animation cadence at every zoom level
observations.qualityVisibility: No visual-quality status or Full detail override is available

limitation: Browser-mounted scene counts, frame time, and GPU traces were unavailable; validate culling and adaptive-versus-full rendering through OPT-FB-008.
